notes: I checked commit fb3336f against each earlier finding in the code. Typecheck is clean and all 23 agents tests pass (~17 s). Fixed: each fan.bought now adds TICKET_RENT_LAMPORTS (1.8M) to the run's spend. Ticket is 8 + 116 = 124 bytes, so real rent is about 1.75M and the constant is slightly conservative. The lifetime per-band cap is gone, so a band's second tour or a 40 € tour no longer starves. With it went the stale grossSettled cache. The FakeChain honours the memcmp state filter at offset 218 ('1'..'5' map to Proposed..Settled). keeper.ts de-duplicates the four reads by pubkey. The header comment no longer says the cap holds across wallets. The hub-balance note uses formatSol. Partly fixed: band-agent.ts names DEMO_DAY_SEC, but as a private copy. KEEPER_RULES.sameDateSec and the web config still each hard-code 2. The per-run budget is checked once per band before FanSim.tick, so one tick can still overshoot it by maxBuysPerTick x (2 x price + rent), about 0.058 SOL on devnet. The only budget test still sets the budget to 0. New: removing the per-band cap leaves nothing per band. One band (one wallet, crafted in-genre proposals at 200 €, 40 tickets) can absorb the whole 0.3 SOL of every run, 144 runs a day, and collect its band share of the settled gross. Bands are served in getProgramAccounts order on a first-come basis, so other bands' shows can get no fans and cancel. The reason still reaches only the keeper console. Still open: Cancelled shows and expired proposals are re-read every tick, with four getProgramAccounts calls per tick. Off-genre is the only case where the offer verdict is enforced, and the share tolerance is 500 bps. FanSim is not seeded from existing tickets, and 'already in use' is retried once before the silent catch. The fairness re-check passes [] for other dates. The mainnet guard is a deny-list. There are no tests for the low-balance pause, failing ticks or the guard. keeper.yml still greps away the keeper's own 429 tick-failure lines, and `end` is set after registration. The core agent work stays strong: venue and band negotiation with track-record-aware asks, the geographic planner with travel and rest days and availability, every Claude decision validated with a heuristic fallback, and no model near a signer. The keeper's anti-drain accounting is now correct per run, but it has no fairness or per-band bound.
issues: packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:250-262: with the per-band cap gone, one band can take the whole per-run budget every run. A wallet proposes in-genre shows at 200 € and 40 tickets to seed venues (keys are public, terms pass venueTermsProblems), absorbs 0.3 SOL x 144 runs/day, and receives its band share of the settled gross. Bands are served in read order, so later bands' shows can stay unsold and cancel. Add a per-band (or per-show) allowance per run, e.g. perRun / selling.size, or a per-band daily cap kept in memory plus the on-chain ticketsSold of live shows, and rotate the start band each tick
